tasks.subject: Task 1: Backend - compute and apply isSensitive masking
tasks.description:
**Goal:** PropertyResponseDto gains isSensitive; PropsManager masks effectiveValue/environmentValue and history propertyValue for sensitive property names; isRedundant stays based on raw values.

**Files:**
- Modify: libs/maia-props-parent/maia-props-spec/src/main/kotlin/org/maiaframework/props/spec/PropsSpec.kt
- Modify: libs/maia-props-parent/maia-props-service/src/main/kotlin/org/maiaframework/props/PropsManager.kt
- Modify: libs/maia-props-parent/maia-props-service/src/test/kotlin/org/maiaframework/props/PropsManagerTest.kt
- Regenerated: libs/maia-props-parent/maia-props-domain/src/generated/... (PropertyResponseDto.kt)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- isSensitive field added to Property response DTO via spec
- sensitivity = name contains password/secret/key/token/credential, case-insensitive
- effectiveValue/environmentValue masked to '******' when sensitive and non-null, stay null when null
- isRedundant computed from raw values, unaffected
- getPropertyHistory masks propertyValue for sensitive properties
- non-sensitive properties fully unaffected
- new tests cover all of the above

**Verify:** ./gradlew :libs:maia-props-parent:maia-props-service:test (from /home/kevin/dev/code/maia) -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL
